fixture.kind: UTF-8 BOM, CRLF, Chinese phrases and Emoji

steps: Confirmed guest product version and build with sw_vers.
Transferred the QA ZIP and fixture over the isolated VM bridge, then verified both SHA-256 values in the guest.
Launched the QA app; selected input.txt using the native Import TXT panel.
Observed the 12.6 MB large-file confirmation with Traditional Chinese / OpenCC Standard and the unchanged existing editor draft.
Used the native save panel to choose input-converted.txt in the guest home directory.
Observed the Conversion Complete sheet and verified the output with guest shasum and wc.
limitations: QA in-memory Pro override is not a StoreKit or RevenueCat entitlement test.
This minimum-system smoke test used 12 MiB, not a 1 GiB fixture.
The app was built on the host with Xcode 27 and run in the macOS 12 guest; it was not built in the guest.
The native UI was observed through VirtualBuddy but no guest screenshot artifact was retained.
